description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting log level, tags, messages, and exceptions for display within a UI component.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying formatted log messages, implementing the LogNode interface, and chaining log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the LogView, also passing it to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a non-null string with a delimiter to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Adds a string as a new line in the log display.
